snippet.title: Forest Puzzle Minis Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for all new PSP/PS3 minis game "Forest Puzzle". The game contains 60 levels of hardcore labyrinths playable in 3 different modes.
More information is available here: http://uk.playstation.com/psp/games/detail/item276685/Forest-Puzzle/
